items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: him about Rick, a guy named Harewood(?)

ctx.x: him about Rick, a guy named Harewood(?). And he tried Rick, and that made him. He was crazy about Rick. So that was good, because Rick was a very steady drummer. The only thing was he would make Joe mad, because if he promised to work with somebody else on a gig before Joe would hand him his list of gigs... Joe thought he should send somebody else on these other gigs. But Rick wasn't that way. If he told you he was going to work for you, he was going to work for you. You know, certain nights, one of them things.…
